description.value: Codes that describe the potential clinical impact of a detected issue.

definition.value: The clinical or pharmacologic effect is expected to be increased for one or more implicated therapies.
The clinical or pharmacologic effect is expected to be decreased for one or more implicated therapies.
Mixed or differing changes in clinical or pharmacologic effects are expected.
An adverse reaction is expected or its risk is increased.
Adverse or undesirable effects are expected to be additive for one or more implicated therapies.
Concurrent use should generally be avoided because of the identified clinical risk.
Concurrent use is contraindicated for a subset of patients based on patient-specific clinical characteristics or circumstances.
